adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, blacklist entries are normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(...toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guests` values are compared without normalization: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` and `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. This makes both the blacklist check and the existing-attendee dedupe case-sensitive, allowing `Spam@x.com` to bypass a `spam@x.com` blacklist entry and potentially create duplicate attendee rows differing only by email case.
